AUTHOR: Marrable
TITLE: Generalised deep learning model for semi-automated length measurement of fish in stereo-BRUVS
SPECIES: Species-agnostic head/tail keypoint detection across 319 species (59 families, 153 genera) in OzFish
DATA: OzFish stereo-BRUVS dataset (AIMS), EventMeasure head/tail annotations; 13,555 cropped stereo pairs after filtering
D2: In-sample (prefix B, G deployments) 70/30 train/val = 5348/2292 pairs; out-of-sample (prefix A, E deployments) 4154 pairs for test
D_EV: Sec. 2.2: 'prefix letters in their filenames to indicate they were taken from different deployments and at different locations ... withheld from any training or validation and made up the out-of-sample data'
R_EV: Sec. 4.4: 'training and testing to data collected at different dates and locations'; Sec. 2.5: 'Inference for both heads and tails was performed on the 4154 out-of-sample data' with Table 1 P/R/F1 and r = 0.99
C_EV: no statement found (Sec. 2.4: 'the one with the highest confidence score was chosen' - no threshold value; FP discussed qualitatively in Sec. 4.2 without a rate)
E_EV: Sec. 2.5: 'the remaining 3954 automated measurements were then compared to the manual measurements made by the fish ecologists'; Fig. 3: 'Pearson correlation coefficient is 0.99'
ARCH: YOLOv5-small retrained to detect 'head' and 'tail' as 25x25 px boxes on cropped fish; lengths computed via EventMeasure stereophotogrammetry (calibration cubes)
METR: Head/tail precision 77.4%, recall 70.0%, F1 73.5% (out-of-sample); Pearson r = 0.99 vs human lengths (n = 3954)
NOTE: D1 and R1: out-of-sample test set is defined by OzFish deployment prefixes (A/E vs B/G) described as different deployments, dates and locations within the same OzFish dataset and region; coded as site-level split and external test (R2 = 복수: site + date). A stricter reading (same dataset, same region) would give R1 = N. In-sample train/val split (70/30) is random at crop level. Reference lengths are human EventMeasure stereo measurements of the same footage, so E5 = same-footage human reading (not independent) despite being stereo length. ~30% of out-of-sample pairs removed by calibration verification and 200 predictions discarded by post-processing (head/tail swapped) - selection could inflate agreement. Fish < 200 px and RMS > 20 mm excluded (size filtering, not visibility). Type coded 기타 (keypoint detection for length), semi-automated with human click.
